Human TATA-Box Promoter (HBB Gene).description: Human beta-globin (HBB) promoter region containing the canonical TATA-box motif (TATAAAA) and upstream GC-boxes.

Human TP53 Exon 5 Cancer Hotspot.description: Core region of exon 5 of the TP53 tumor suppressor gene, site of frequent human somatic cancer mutations (e.g. R175, G245).

Human BRCA1 Splice Site Region.description: BRCA1 splice junction region associated with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer predisposition.

Synthetic Enhancer (E-Box / AP-1 Motifs).description: Synthetic regulatory sequence containing tandem E-box motifs (CACGTG) and AP-1 binding sites (TGACTCA).
